author: Pasang Geljen Sherpa
review_text: eSewa is a game-changer in financial services, making transactions effortless and accessible. Whether paying bills, transferring funds, or recharging mobile balances, eSewa simplifies everything with a user-friendly interface. It’s secure, fast, and eliminates the need for physical cash. This app has truly transformed the way I manage my finances, offering convenience at my fingertips. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a hassle-free financial experience!

author: Emroze Azam
review_text: It's a hassle. My account went dormant, need to send sms from own number, after sending sms says try again. My other account I need to login on my phone.
